name: Heathrow / London controlled airspace reference geometry

metadata.important: Not for navigation or operational flight planning. Flight levels are stored as approximate feet/metres only for visual extrusion; FL is pressure-referenced, not a true geometric altitude.
metadata.authoritative_source: NATS UK AIP / UK ICAO AIP Dataset (AIXM 5.1)
